checks.name: 3개월 수익률 하위 3(순서)
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND coalesce(TRY_CAST(du_er_3m AS DOUBLE),0)<>0 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(du_er_3m AS DOUBLE) ASC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 3

checks.name: 추적오차 상위 5
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND coalesce(TRY_CAST(du_chas_errt AS DOUBLE),0)<>0 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(du_chas_errt AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 5

checks.name: 거래량 상위 5
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND coalesce(TRY_CAST(du_vol_1d AS DOUBLE),0)<>0 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(du_vol_1d AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 5

checks.name: 반도체 표기 1~2등급 순자산 상위 3(순서)
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND (pd_nm ILIKE '%반도체%' OR pd_abrv_nm ILIKE '%반도체%') AND TRY_CAST(drv_risk_grade AS INT) BETWEEN 1 AND 2 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3

checks.name: AAA 특수채 표면금리 상위 3(순서)
checks.sql: SELECT PD_ABRV_NM, PD_NM FROM kr_bond WHERE STD_PD_MCLS_NM='특수채' AND drv_maturity_status='active' AND TRY_CAST(drv_crd_grd_rank AS INT)=1 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(SRFC_IRT AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, PD_NO LIMIT 3

checks.name: 만기 2년 이내 회사채 세후수익률 상위 3(순서)
checks.sql: SELECT PD_ABRV_NM, PD_NM FROM kr_bond WHERE STD_PD_MCLS_NM='회사채' AND drv_maturity_status='active' AND replace(coalesce(MAT_DT,''),'-','') BETWEEN strftime(current_date, '%Y%m%d') AND strftime(current_date + INTERVAL 2 YEAR, '%Y%m%d') ORDER BY TRY_CAST(AFTER_TAX_YIELD AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, TRY_CAST(drv_crd_grd_rank AS INT) NULLS LAST, TRY_CAST(SRFC_IRT AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, replace(MAT_DT,'-',''), PD_NO LIMIT 3

checks.name: 회사채 AAA 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM kr_bond WHERE STD_PD_MCLS_NM='회사채' AND drv_maturity_status='active' AND drv_crd_grd_norm='AAA'

checks.name: 무등급 채권 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM kr_bond WHERE drv_crd_grd_rank IS NULL OR trim(coalesce(drv_crd_grd_norm,''))=''

checks.name: 채권형 5~6등급 공모펀드
checks.sql: SELECT itm_abrv_nm, itm_nm FROM fund_master WHERE or_attr_desc='채권형' AND TRY_CAST(drv_risk_grade AS INT) BETWEEN 5 AND 6 ORDER BY CASE WHEN replace(trim(coalesce(sale_yn,'')), ' ', '')='판매중' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, itm_no LIMIT 20

checks.name: 주식형×1등급 건수

checks.name: 주식형 전체 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fund_master WHERE or_attr_desc ILIKE '%주식형%'

checks.name: 클래스 수 최다 펀드
checks.sql: SELECT itm_abrv_nm, itm_nm FROM fund_master ORDER BY TRY_CAST(share_class_count AS INT) DESC NULLS LAST, itm_no LIMIT 1

checks.name: 미래에셋…TDF 공모펀드
checks.sql: SELECT itm_abrv_nm, itm_nm FROM fund_master WHERE itm_nm ILIKE '%미래에셋%TDF%' OR itm_abrv_nm ILIKE '%미래에셋%TDF%' ORDER BY CASE WHEN replace(trim(coalesce(sale_yn,'')), ' ', '')='판매중' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, itm_no LIMIT 20

checks.name: 미국 지역 총보수 0.03% 이하
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM global_etf WHERE wu_inv_rgn ILIKE '%United States%' AND TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE) > 0 AND TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE) <= 0.03 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(du_last_aum AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 20

checks.name: iShares 해외 ETF 총보수 단순 평균
checks.sql: SELECT round(avg(TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE)),2) FROM global_etf WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND coalesce(TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE),0)>0 AND (cu_fund_mgmt_co ILIKE '%iShares%' OR regexp_matches(pd_nm, '(^|[^A-Za-z0-9])iShares([^A-Za-z0-9]|$)', 'i'))

checks.name: 삼성전자 미편입 반도체 ETF 상위 3(순서)
checks.sql: SELECT e.pd_abrv_nm, e.pd_nm FROM kr_etp e WHERE e.drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND e.drv_listing_status='active' AND (e.pd_nm ILIKE '%반도체%' OR e.pd_abrv_nm ILIKE '%반도체%') AND e.pd_itm_no IN (SELECT DISTINCT etf_isin FROM etf_constituent) AND e.pd_itm_no NOT IN (SELECT etf_isin FROM etf_constituent WHERE COMPST_ISU_CD='005930') ORDER BY TRY_CAST(e.pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, e.pd_itm_no LIMIT 3

checks.name: 국내ETF 2등급 건수
